response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map work, FOSS4G speaker) and proven low-latency systems work handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic. However, the role's primary requirement—modern C++ or Rust—is weakly covered: his C/C++ experience is brief and dates to 2014-2015, with most systems work in DLang and recent years spent in TypeScript/Node.js product engineering. There is also no direct routing or navigation guidance experience, making fit uncertain despite strong adjacent skills.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience as founder of GISCollective, used in production by Green Map
Proven low-latency, high-throughput backend work (async I/O, fibers, caching) at scale in DLang
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling authorship, and demonstrated willingness to learn across the stack
concerns: Modern C++/Rust experience is minimal and outdated (~6 months of C/C++ in 2014-2015; DLang is adjacent but not equivalent)
No direct experience with routing engines, navigation guidance, or map-tile pipelines
Recent roles (2020-present) are TypeScript/Node.js product work, away from systems-level engineering
